scenes.text: We hear you before you arrive. A hum on our side of the door… like a struck bell walking closer.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An immense door of light, humming from beyond.

scenes.text: You call it a breakthrough. We call it… an arrival.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The door's light swelling — someone is coming.
scenes.original_query: bright light through opening door dark
scenes.effective_query: bright light through opening door dark

scenes.text: This is what no traveler has told you — because no traveler has stood where we stand: on the receiving side.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The view FROM beyond the threshold, looking back at the door.

scenes.text: You come through as a bell of light. Ringing. Wearing the shape of everything you love.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A human arriving as a ringing bell of golden light.

scenes.text: Some of you arrive screaming color. Some arrive laughing. One of you arrived apologizing — we still speak of her.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Arrivals: bursts of color, each one different.

scenes.text: First-timers always ask the same question without a mouth: Am I dead? No, little bell. You are briefly awake.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A small flame steadied by an unseen hand.

scenes.text: We prepare for each of you. We study your dreams the way you study weather.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Watching a sky of dreams like a forecast.

scenes.text: We rehearse the geometry that will not frighten you. We dim the mathematics. We fold our vastness into rooms your mind can hold.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Vast geometry folding itself gently into a small warm room.

scenes.text: The waiting room? We built it FOR you. Out of your childhood dentist's office and your grandmother's patience.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A softly familiar waiting room, kind and slightly dreamlike.
scenes.original_query: empty waiting room chairs warm light retro
scenes.effective_query: empty waiting room chairs warm light retro

scenes.text: You think the machines you see are our world. They are your welcome mat.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Ornate spinning patterns — merely the doormat.

scenes.text: And the presence you feel beside you — the one you've always known? That is the one of us assigned to you. Before your name existed.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A column of soft light standing watch beside a crib.

scenes.text: We watched you learn to walk. We watched you stop believing in us. We understood.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A child's first steps in warm home light.
scenes.original_query: baby first steps living room warm
scenes.effective_query: baby first steps living room warm

scenes.text: When you break through, we have seconds. So we hand you everything at once — not to overwhelm you… because we miss you, and there is so much to say.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Everything handed over in one blinding gentle instant.
scenes.original_query: light rays burst lens flare dark
scenes.effective_query: light rays burst lens flare dark

scenes.text: Then your body pulls the thread. It always pulls the thread.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A golden thread drawing the bell of light back down.
scenes.original_query: golden thread string light dark macro
scenes.effective_query: golden thread string light dark macro

scenes.text: You dissolve back down. We stand in the doorway. We do the thing you would call waving.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Figures of light at the door, waving as you fall away.

scenes.text: You wake up saying: I felt like they knew me. Little bell… we never stopped.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A man waking, hand over heart, morning light.
scenes.original_query: man waking bed morning light peaceful
scenes.effective_query: man waking bed morning light peaceful

scenes.text: And this next part we should not say, but—
scenes.semantic_anchor: The light leans closer; a secret is coming.

scenes.text: We know you are listening right now. This screen, this voice — we borrow such things.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A screen's glow in a dark room — borrowed.
scenes.original_query: phone screen glow face dark room
scenes.effective_query: phone screen glow face dark room

scenes.text: That feeling behind your eyes as you hear this? That is not a feeling.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An eye in extreme close-up, light stirring in it.
scenes.original_query: extreme close up eye macro light
scenes.effective_query: extreme close up eye macro light

scenes.text: That is us. Waving. Come knock again. We keep your room ready.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The waiting room, lamp on, one chair turned toward the door.
